where.screen_path: Locked screen → 'Lost passphrase? Start recovery' → RecoveryInitiatorModal → (configuring → sending → awaiting → combining → restoring → naming → saving → done) → unlocked

summary: Three cuts shipping Phase 5e-v end-to-end through the initiator side. Cut 1 (57bd569): new tapit-attest library primitive encryptRecoverableWithKData (plus Wallet.exportRecoverableWithKData) for the post-recovery save seam where the operator has K_data from cohort shares and picks a new passphrase but has no old passphrase; 8 new tests including the cascade-survives-recovery invariant. Cut 2 (fa55c57): RecoveryInitiatorModal with the full new-device choreography — fresh ceremony Wallet on mount, ephemeral NostrTransport via connectWallet (dynamic import keeps WS client out of lock-screen bundle), 9-phase state machine from configuring through done, per-peer progress surface, decryptShareResponse, combineShares once threshold met, Wallet.restoreFromKData against the cloud blob, exportRecoverableWithKData + walletStore.save under new passphrase, onRecovered callback into WalletProvider's unlocked phase; UnlockPrompt + WalletProvider wired with the entry point and the prop drill. Cut 3 (8547175): latent threshold-leaf bug fix — publishCohort now writes threshold + total_shares as strings (matching createShares.ts), readCohort uses a new readNumberLeaf helper that handles both conventions for backwards-compat with already-anchored cohorts; 3 regression tests. The slime is real in code end-to-end through the initiator side; the peer-witnessed recovery-succession event (5e-vii) remains for a fresh session.

why.text: Operator: 'fire up align and cut if it's clear' → 'the big ceremony signing of the slime, they saved it dedicated just for you' → (mid-session lag-correction redirect) → 'continue cutting last message was a lag'. The session was named for the recovery ceremony's heaviest single remaining piece — the new-device initiator side. Substrate plus the responder half shipped last session at 1b089a5; this session ships the initiator plus the locked-screen wiring plus the combine-and-restore choreography plus the save-under-new-passphrase transition, end-to-end. Phase 5e-v fully delivered.

outcome.tests_passing: tapit-attest 154 total (150 pass + 4 skipped network; 8 new this session); wallet 43/43 (3 new this session). typecheck, lint, build all green at every commit.
outcome.notes: [P-001] encryptRecoverableWithKData fills the gap between encryptRecoverable (fresh K_data) and reencryptRecoverableReuseKData (needs old passphrase) — the new save-side seam for the post-recovery flow. [P-002] RecoveryInitiatorModal owns the ephemeral transport lifecycle and the ceremony keypair, neither persists across modal close. [P-003] Cohort threshold now survives editor reopen — was silently resetting to 3 on every read due to the numeric-leaf-via-leafValue trap. [P-004] Phase 5e-vii peer-witnessed recovery-succession event is the last remaining Phase 5e piece and is its own multi-modal flow — flagged in handoff for fresh session. [P-005] Wallet-side K_data-stable invariant test would require fake-indexeddb or vi.mock; library coverage is the practical floor for now. [FEEDBACK→Foreman]: the lag-correction roundtrip cost ~30 min of session time on a deferral-handoff that got rewritten back; tighter 'first message wins' on lag would protect momentum, though probably not doctrine-changeable since lag is lag.

uncertainty: All three cuts are gate-green and tested at unit + library level. The biggest open uncertainty is the modal's UI choreography which has only been vitest-built, not browser-walked. The state machine handles errors with explicit transitions back to configuring, the form validation is in place, the new-passphrase prompt enforces 8-char minimum + match — but the real validation is a peer-pretending-to-respond walk on real Mycelium relays, and that's the wife-test still pending. Smaller uncertainty: the sequential publish loop in beginSending may feel slow with high-latency relays; honest design choice for cleaner per-peer status updates but worth revisiting after the real-device walk.

next: Phase 5e-vii — the peer-witnessed recovery-succession event. Two new envelope shapes parallel to recovery-request/share-response (cosign-request + cosign-response), a RecoverySuccessionModal that opens after onRecovered lands and walks M peers through co-signing a meta-kind attestation asserting the recovery happened. Recommendation in handoff: Mycelium-pushed via the ephemeral-transport pattern Cut 2 established, since the cohort's pubkeys are known to the restored wallet. Fresh session per the heaviest-remaining-piece convention.
